metric: Pairs shown different by a constraint-respecting database on which both queries were run (DuckDB), and pairs on which 600 random databases (and every database of at most 2 rows per table) showed no difference (not a proof, not bounded verification).
correctness: Every refutation was executed on both queries, is stable under row-order shuffles, and shows with DuckDB's optimizer off too; none are claimed without a database
caveats: Full corpus (23,994 pairs). No labels. MySQL source run on DuckDB; 1,923 pairs are not run (DuckDB rejects them, mostly bare words used as strings or ambiguous columns). Search settings were tuned on a 1,000-pair sample (every 24th pair), so the other pairs are held out from that tuning. In this row 'unknown' counts pairs that agree on every database tried and 'unsupported' counts pairs DuckDB or the parser rejects.
held_out: Search settings tuned on every 24th pair (1,000); the other 22,994 pairs are unseen: 3,233 of the 3,586 pairs VeriEQL refutes are refuted here too (90%).
